measurement_scope: isolated additive font recovery plus strict report serialization with the font audit prepared outside the timed region; Phase 0 parse records are historical per-case comparators, not paired full-parser samples

method.combined_ceiling: arithmetic sum of independently measured retained P02-US01 healthy audit p95 and current healthy recovery p95; a conservative ceiling reference, not an observed or paired full-parser percentile
method.healthy_comparator: each isolated recovery duration divided by the immutable per-case Phase 0 parse latency
method.isolation: one child process per corpus case
method.per_font_timing: catastrophe audit filtered to one finding per measured recovery; each pass still scans the real PDF page
method.rss: isolated-process peak RSS increment after audit precomputation, from before lazy recovery import through full-document and per-font recovery samples
method.source_identity: each PDF SHA-256 matched its immutable Phase 0 source record
method.timed_region: recover_pdf_font_text plus Pydantic mode=json report serialization; audit precomputed before timing
